lesson.intro: Es el 'llevaba… haciendo algo' del español: la duración de una actividad hasta un momento del pasado.
when: Cuánto tiempo llevaba pasando algo cuando ocurrió otra cosa (I had been waiting for an hour when she finally arrived).
La causa de una situación pasada que se notaba (They were wet because they had been walking in the rain).
Con how long, for y since, igual que el present perfect continuous pero un paso más atrás en el tiempo.
Los verbos de estado van en past perfect simple: I had known him for years.

form.label: Estructura
items: had been + verbo-ing (igual para todas las personas)
I'd been waiting / She'd been working
Negativa: I hadn't been sleeping well
Pregunta: How long had you been living there?

examples.en: I had been waiting for an hour when she finally arrived.
examples.es: Llevaba una hora esperando cuando por fin llegó.

examples.en: They were wet because they had been walking in the rain.
examples.es: Estaban mojados porque habían estado caminando bajo la lluvia.

examples.en: How long had you been living there before you moved?
examples.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo llevabas viviendo allí antes de mudarte?

examples.en: She had been working there for ten years when she got promoted.
examples.es: Llevaba diez años trabajando allí cuando la ascendieron.

errors.wrong: I was waiting for two hours when he arrived.
errors.right: I had been waiting for two hours when he arrived.
errors.why: 'Llevaba dos horas' hasta ese momento: had been + -ing.

errors.wrong: I had been knowing him for years.
errors.right: I had known him for years.
errors.why: 'Know' es de estado: past perfect simple.

errors.wrong: I had been wait for an hour.
errors.right: I had been waiting for an hour.
errors.why: Después de 'been' va el verbo con -ing.

lesson.tip: 'Llevaba + tiempo + gerundio' en español casi siempre se traduce con had been + -ing.
